name: Billing dashboard
purpose: A billing overview: volume, revenue, outstanding and overdue KPIs, overdue invoices to chase and upcoming payouts.
description: The dashboard template filled for a billing product: four KPIs with deltas, a Needs attention panel listing overdue invoices with critical Badges, and an Upcoming payouts panel with dates and amounts.
whenToUse: Starting point for the home page of a billing or invoicing product.
whenNotToUse: As a component: copy it and replace the data with your queries.
rules: Keep money in Text numeric, end-aligned.
Overdue is critical; in transit is info; scheduled is neutral.
Create invoice is the page's only primary Button.
